feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Questions about FAA funding roil Capitol Hill after nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: Three days after a communications meltdown led the FAA to ground planes, there are big questions about what happened and how much money is needed to upgrade the country's air traffic control system.

entry.title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
entry.summary: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

entry.title: If Robert Pattinson is James Bond, 007 needs to get a little weird
entry.summary: Amazon announced Monday that Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond. NPR critic Glen Weldon says the idiosyncratic actor would seem to be a better fit as a Bond villain.

entry.title: Pilot and journalist says fault lines beginning to show in U.S. air travel
entry.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with James Fallows about his reporting on the safety of air travel, published in the New York Times Magazine the day before the nationwide ground stop.

entry.title: U.S. tightens controls on remote access to AI technology amid Nvidia fallout
entry.summary: The new rule closes a loophole that existed that allowed Chinese companies to still access advanced AI chips remotely, despite U.S. restrictions on their physical sale to China.

entry.title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
entry.summary: Countries are meeting in Geneva to negotiate rules on weapons that can select and kill targets without human intervention. But with the U.S., Russia and Israel resisting legally binding controls, campaigners fear the window to act is closing.

entry.title: A family runs afoul of the Russian mob in the terrific 'Paper Tiger'
entry.summary: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller star in a film that isn't merely one of this year's very best films; it possesses a weight and depth you rarely find in American movies anymore.

entry.title: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond
entry.summary: "We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007," Denis Villeneuve, who will direct the new Bond film, said in an announcement from Amazon MGM Studios.

entry.title: Lindsay Clancy to face a new trial in spring of 2027 over children's killing
entry.summary: A new trial is set in Massachusetts against Lindsay Clancy as prosecutors seek a criminal conviction over the killing of her three young children.

entry.title: RAYE and Rosalía lead the 2027 Grammy nominations
entry.summary: The nominations for the 69th annual Grammy Awards were announced on Monday, and women artists across genres rule the major categories.
